evidence.claim: Obsidian documentation states that notes are stored as Markdown plain text files in a local folder.
Notion's product page presents the product as a connected workspace for teams.

recommendations.statement: Ship Markdown import, export, and visible backup status.
recommendations.acceptance_signal: An imported folder round-trips without changing file names or note content.

recommendations.statement: Add local search with source-file provenance.
recommendations.acceptance_signal: Every result opens its source file and line context.

recommendations.statement: Evaluate sharing after local ownership workflows are proven.
recommendations.acceptance_signal: Five target users complete a sharing prototype without losing local ownership.
